typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		order_id as string,
		outcome_code as string,
		event_date as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/KPIF_Recon_*']) ~> source1
ConditionalSplit1@Upsert select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Id = order_id,
		Status__c = outcome_code,
		Fulfilled__c = event_date
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
addADFId split(isNull(order_id)||isNull(event_date),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, Upsert)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull(order_id), 'order_id ', ''), iif(isNull(event_date), 'event_date ', ''))) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['KPIF_Recon_Fulfillment_Orders__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toUpsert
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['KPIF_Recon_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['KPIF_Recon_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
